title_sq: SHITET APARTAMENT 2+1 NË RRUGËN E KOSOVARËVE – PAS HOTEL DINASTY

title_en: 2+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE ON KOSOVAREV STREET - BEHIND DINASTY HOTEL
description_en: 📍 Location: Rruga e Kosovare, behind Dinasty Hotel 🏢 Floor: 3 🛗 Building with elevator - built in 2003 The apartment is positioned in one of the most sought-after areas of Tirana, with quick access to: 🟢 Lake Park 🏫 Educational and state institutions 🛍 Services and public transport lines 🏠 Interior organization: Distribution corridor Living room + kitchen 2 bedrooms 1 bathroom 1 laundry room (possibility of a second toilet) 1 balcony The apartment needs reinvestment, offering customization options to your liking. 🧱 The project of the new facade with hood system has been approved by the Municipality of Tirana - 50% of the amount has been collected by the residents, while the remaining 50% will be financed by the Municipality. 📐 The floor plan is available and can be sent to you upon request. 📞 For more information or for a visit to the property, contact us!
